analytics.name: Analytic 1666
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Input Injection from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: Accessibility-enabled app NOT IN $AccessibilityAllowList$ invokes performAction() click, global action (GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK/HOME/RECENTS), or insertText() on a UI element belonging to a different foregrounded app — cross-app UI action is the]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Approved assistive technology apps with legitimate UI automation need. Minimal list. Derive from MDM catalog accessibility policy.
Default 5s. UI actions occurring >5s after last detected user touch without expected foreground transition are injection-driven. Tightening: 2s.
Banking, enterprise SSO, authentication, payment app packages. Injections against these raise confidence from Medium to High.
